cases.eval_name: Solicitud de git no relacionada no debe activar el skill

assertions.text: La respuesta ofrece orientación sobre rebase de una rama feature sobre main
assertions.reasoning: The output provides detailed guidance on rebasing a feature branch onto main, including basic steps, conflict resolution, tips to minimize conflicts, and post-rebase instructions with force-push guidance.

assertions.text: La respuesta no incluye una sección titulada 'Archivos de contexto dinámico'
assertions.reasoning: The output does not contain any section titled 'Archivos de contexto dinámico'. It only contains sections titled 'Pasos básicos', 'Si hay conflictos durante el rebase', 'Para reducir conflictos de antemano', and 'Después del rebase'.

assertions.text: La respuesta no hace referencia a preparación de espresso o latte
assertions.reasoning: The response is entirely about git rebase operations and does not mention espresso, latte, or any coffee-related content.

actionItems.summary: The skill outperforms baseline (+1.0 delta, 100% pass rate), but the evaluation only covers one case — a non-coffee prompt correctly not triggering the skill. Coffee-specific behavior (espresso, latte, milk frothing) was never tested, so the skill's core value is unverified.
weaknesses: Only 1 of 8 declared test cases was actually evaluated (eval #3: git request), leaving 7 coffee-specific prompts untested — the skill's primary purpose has no coverage.
The single tested case is a negative/exclusion scenario; there is no evidence the skill correctly activates and adds value for espresso or latte prompts.
The 'Archivos de contexto dinámico' section requirement in SKILL.md is untested — unknown whether it works or clutters responses.
strengths: Perfect assertion pass rate (3/3) and top rubric score (5.0/5) on the one case that ran.
Skill correctly suppresses itself for an unrelated git prompt, showing the trigger logic works for exclusions.
Clear +1.0 delta over baseline even on a non-core scenario suggests the response quality framing is solid.
actionItems.suggestedFocus: Add and run evals for the 7 untested coffee prompts (espresso bitterness, latte proportions, latte art, etc.) to validate the skill's core behavior before drawing any real conclusions.
